text:
Hakone's station luggage desk
stops taking bags at 12:00.
Arrive after lunch and you carry it 👇

🤔 A or B? Pick one, then see what we found 👉 https://japanbystation.com/hakone-big-suitcase-forward-carry-store

🧳 How it works
Drop your case at Hakone-Yumoto Station.
Find it at your hotel after 15:00.
Drop-off runs 8:30–12:00 only.
Same-day online bookings close at 11:30.

✅ Before you go
Reach Yumoto by late morning.
Check your ryokan is a partner hotel.
Regular up to 140 cm, 15 kg: ¥1,500.
Large up to 200 cm, 30 kg: ¥2,500.

🔁 It runs downhill too.
Hotel desk by 10:00,
pick up at Yumoto 13:30–18:30.

👉 How to use the same desk on your last morning:
https://japanbystation.com/hakone-big-suitcase-forward-carry-store
